text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further by checking how different parts of a system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Although writing tests takes extra time, it gives developers confidence. When tests pass, the team knows that changes have not broken existing features. In the end, good testing saves time and leads to more reliable software.
